00de2536d47e.en: First Subjugation Period (~5,000 to ~4,500 B.G.): with the Finaies out of the picture and the Lishies out of reach, their society flourished. Having modified Wingas into Big Wingas and Yabuca trees into Wood People and bent them to their will, they researched how to subjugate the other two races. Wingarest became the home of the Big Wingas. The Wood People were created by altering the souls of Yabuca trees, then confined to small forests across the Buhraies Plains, where they produced food and lumber in a controlled way. Their goal: subjugate and experiment on the Finaies in the north, and fix and terraform Hifuna.
00de2536d47e.t: Periode Penaklukan Pertama (~5.000 sampai ~4.500 B.G.): dengan para Finaies tersingkir dan para Lishies tak terjangkau, masyarakat mereka berkembang. Setelah memodifikasi Winga menjadi Big Winga dan pohon Yabuca menjadi Wood People dan menundukkan mereka, mereka meneliti cara menaklukkan dua ras lainnya. Wingarest menjadi rumah Big Winga. Wood People diciptakan dengan mengubah jiwa pohon-pohon Yabuca, lalu dikurung di hutan-hutan kecil di seluruh Buhraies Plains, tempat mereka menghasilkan makanan dan kayu secara terkendali. Tujuan mereka: menaklukkan dan bereksperimen pada para Finaies di utara, serta memperbaiki dan mengubah bentuk Hifuna.

01e35785d15a.en: The Buhraies decided to test everything they knew about subjugation on the Fuhraies, but it didn't work, and they fought. Or rather, the Fuhraies kept defending themselves from the Buhraies' weak attacks: being fleshy, the Buhraies weren't used to such cold weather and altitude. Negotiations never worked.
01e35785d15a.t: Para Buhraies memutuskan menguji semua yang mereka ketahui tentang penaklukan pada para Fuhraies, tapi tidak berhasil, dan mereka pun bertempur. Atau lebih tepatnya, para Fuhraies terus bertahan dari serangan lemah para Buhraies: karena bertubuh daging, para Buhraies tidak terbiasa dengan cuaca sedingin itu dan ketinggian seperti itu. Negosiasi tak pernah berhasil.

01e61492a86b.en: Once a person's heart is replaced with a stone, they can only feel the emotion set in it. Most who tried it died, going berserk or taking their own lives, among other reasons. The few who could live with a stone became legends. The stone also seeps into the person's soul, corrupting it and causing many symptoms, including being impossible to revive.
01e61492a86b.t: Begitu jantung seseorang diganti dengan batu, ia hanya bisa merasakan emosi yang tertanam di dalamnya. Kebanyakan yang mencobanya mati, mengamuk atau mengakhiri hidupnya sendiri, di antara alasan lain. Segelintir yang bisa hidup dengan batu itu menjadi legenda. Batu itu juga meresap ke jiwa orang itu, merusaknya dan menyebabkan banyak gejala, termasuk mustahil dihidupkan kembali.

027433560234.en: Mountain Overtake Period (~250 to ~270 A.G.): the Darfaries killed everyone, their history included. But Wozefaries and Sorefaries kept being born: their blood was tainted forever, and some Darfaries grew uneasy about killing their own babies for the sake of purity. That's when the first king, Gandew, established the Goodbye Cliff, from which every Wozefaries and Sorefaries was sent flying toward Flatland. Anyone who didn't accept it had to leave. With the ancient species kicked out, the Darfaries named the mountain Gandew after their first king, claiming it as their own.
027433560234.t: Periode Perebutan Gunung (~250 sampai ~270 A.G.): para Darfaries membunuh semua orang, termasuk sejarah mereka. Tapi Wozefaries dan Sorefaries terus lahir: darah mereka tercemar selamanya, dan sebagian Darfaries mulai gelisah membunuh bayi mereka sendiri demi kemurnian. Saat itulah raja pertama, Gandew, menetapkan Goodbye Cliff, tempat setiap Wozefaries dan Sorefaries dilempar terbang ke arah Flatland. Siapa pun yang tidak menerimanya harus pergi. Dengan spesies purba terusir, para Darfaries menamai gunung itu Gandew dari nama raja pertama mereka, mengklaimnya sebagai milik mereka.

02ff2cf75787.en: The Last Breath Time (~855 B.G. to ~380 A.G.)
02ff2cf75787.t: Masa Napas Terakhir (~855 B.G. sampai ~380 A.G.)

043219ba4522.en: Lishies Subjugation Period (~4,500 to ~3,500 B.G.): they tried to subjugate the Lishies, but not only did it fail, it led the Lishies to discover how to get up onto the Buhraies Plains. The Lishies were hard to fight there, and the peaceful life on the plains was over: the Buhraies researched how to keep the Lishies at bay while skirmishing nearly every week. ~3,575 B.G.: the Lishies launched a war against the Buhraies, and both sides were decimated as the battle raged on.
043219ba4522.t: Periode Penaklukan Lishies (~4.500 sampai ~3.500 B.G.): mereka berusaha menaklukkan para Lishies, tapi tak hanya gagal, itu malah membuat para Lishies menemukan cara naik ke atas Buhraies Plains. Para Lishies sulit dilawan di sana, dan hidup damai di dataran itu pun berakhir: para Buhraies meneliti cara menjauhkan para Lishies sambil bertempur kecil nyaris setiap minggu. ~3.575 B.G.: para Lishies melancarkan perang melawan para Buhraies, dan kedua pihak hancur-hancuran saat pertempuran berkecamuk.

0637cad88a3e.en: ~6,000 to ~5,000 B.G.: the Buhraies created their plains and separated themselves. The Lishies kept trying to reach them for payback, but without a Soul Energy interface, they couldn't.
0637cad88a3e.t: ~6.000 sampai ~5.000 B.G.: para Buhraies menciptakan dataran mereka dan memisahkan diri. Para Lishies terus berusaha mencapai mereka untuk membalas, tapi tanpa antarmuka Energi Jiwa, mereka tak bisa.

09dc8c9ecef5.en: ~805 B.G.: a massive civil war broke out in Aldemeri, which burned for days, all instigated by humans. Some residents less inclined toward war fled to other cities (or to Flatland) and tried to stop another civil war. Several Lishies fled into what is now Flatland and made a pact with the Buhraies after a battle that thinned both sides.
09dc8c9ecef5.t: ~805 B.G.: perang saudara besar-besaran pecah di Aldemeri, yang membara berhari-hari, semuanya dihasut manusia. Sebagian penduduk yang kurang condong pada perang kabur ke kota lain (atau ke Flatland) dan berusaha mencegah perang saudara lain. Beberapa Lishies kabur ke wilayah yang kini Flatland dan membuat perjanjian dengan para Buhraies setelah pertempuran yang menipiskan kedua pihak.

130c253cf332.en: Embassies were founded soon after, and all ruins and major cities became Forway property. Sundeath tried to stay out of it all, but gave in under the sheer pressure from Forway; in exchange, it has Pharaohs as city leaders.
130c253cf332.t: Kedutaan didirikan tak lama kemudian, dan semua reruntuhan dan kota besar menjadi milik Forway. Sundeath berusaha tidak ikut campur, tapi menyerah di bawah tekanan luar biasa dari Forway; sebagai gantinya, Sundeath punya Firaun sebagai pemimpin kota.

1392a673412a.en: Muscle Development Period (~15,000 to ~10,000 B.G.): the Finaies in the deep forest developed a taste for meat, and their bodies changed slightly, then a lot, as they became excellent hunters. The females preferred beefy, fleshy men, so they steered evolution toward losing the Finaies interface altogether. The Lishies became a new species.
1392a673412a.t: Periode Perkembangan Otot (~15.000 sampai ~10.000 B.G.): para Finaies di hutan dalam mulai menyukai daging, dan tubuh mereka berubah sedikit, lalu banyak, saat mereka menjadi pemburu yang hebat. Para betina lebih menyukai lelaki yang kekar dan berdaging, jadi mereka mengarahkan evolusi untuk kehilangan antarmuka Finaies sama sekali. Para Lishies menjadi spesies baru.

171588837ff0.en: Greedy Humans Period (~570 to ~680 A.G.): many Wozefaries and Sorefaries spread throughout the kingdoms. Some knew how to grease the wheels to get a good life; others ended up as slaves (see The Greed Period under Humans).
171588837ff0.t: Periode Manusia Serakah (~570 sampai ~680 A.G.): banyak Wozefaries dan Sorefaries menyebar ke seluruh kerajaan. Sebagian tahu cara memuluskan jalan demi hidup yang baik; yang lain berakhir menjadi budak (lihat Periode Keserakahan di bagian Manusia).

182cd4f6ad3e.en: Later on, they made a pact with the Flingas to watch over the south and plan a comeback.
182cd4f6ad3e.t: Kemudian, mereka membuat perjanjian dengan para Flinga untuk mengawasi selatan dan merencanakan kebangkitan.

19965731952c.en: ~495 B.G.: humans took over Flatland as the ancient species fled into the desert.
19965731952c.t: ~495 B.G.: manusia merebut Flatland saat spesies purba kabur ke gurun.

1a7b2d5e3430.en: Mountain Pact Period (~500 B.G. to ~250 A.G.):
1a7b2d5e3430.t: Periode Perjanjian Gunung (~500 B.G. sampai ~250 A.G.):

1a868485ea58.en: In this period, they discovered the power of souls and Walking Heart stones and created an endless army with them. One of the humans brought back to life was really good at mineralogy, so his knowledge was extracted, and with it, English names for minerals stuck in the Vraki language: gold, iron, magnesium and so on.
1a868485ea58.t: Pada periode ini, mereka menemukan kekuatan jiwa dan batu Walking Heart dan menciptakan pasukan tanpa akhir dengannya. Salah satu manusia yang dihidupkan kembali sangat pandai mineralogi, jadi pengetahuannya diekstrak, dan bersamanya, nama-nama mineral dalam bahasa Inggris melekat dalam bahasa Vraki: gold, iron, magnesium, dan sebagainya.

1c09e211ee4f.en: The Pact (~500 B.G.): seeing how voracious the humans' attacks were, the Fuhraies agreed to a pact with the Buhraies, and from then on their story is intertwined with the Buhraies' (see The Last Breath Time under Buhraies).
1c09e211ee4f.t: Perjanjian (~500 B.G.): melihat betapa rakusnya serangan manusia, para Fuhraies menyetujui perjanjian dengan para Buhraies, dan sejak itu kisah mereka terjalin dengan kisah para Buhraies (lihat Masa Napas Terakhir di bagian Buhraies).

1e82c76b5508.en: Licking their wounds (mostly emotional) after losing Endlessfog Island to Lishies they thought too dumb to plan anything, they stopped all battles and focused on research.
1e82c76b5508.t: Menjilati luka mereka (kebanyakan luka emosional) setelah kehilangan Pulau Endlessfog kepada para Lishies yang mereka kira terlalu bodoh untuk merencanakan apa pun, mereka menghentikan semua pertempuran dan berfokus pada riset.

2002e841c7c2.en: More earth came from where the Lukewarm Buhraies Lake is now. They built an underground structure that pipes its water to Wingarest.
2002e841c7c2.t: Lebih banyak tanah diambil dari tempat yang kini Lukewarm Buhraies Lake. Mereka membangun struktur bawah tanah yang mengalirkan airnya ke Wingarest.

256c6905e619.en: Fost stones formed during the process, from Soul Energy interfering deep within the land. The Buhraies used them as a light source; the Lishies eventually learned about them, but never used them widely, since fire pits were easier.
256c6905e619.t: Batu Fost terbentuk selama proses itu, dari Energi Jiwa yang mengganggu jauh di dalam tanah. Para Buhraies memakainya sebagai sumber cahaya; para Lishies akhirnya mengetahuinya, tapi tak pernah memakainya secara luas, karena lubang api lebih mudah.

26bbb2f10eaf.en: The Prosperity Treaty Period (680 A.G. to today): the Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries became equal to humans under the law (see The Prosperity Treaty Period under Humans).
26bbb2f10eaf.t: Periode Perjanjian Kemakmuran (680 A.G. sampai hari ini): para Darfaries, Wozefaries, dan Sorefaries menjadi setara dengan manusia di mata hukum (lihat Periode Perjanjian Kemakmuran di bagian Manusia).

26e73987c5b3.en: ~2,100 B.G.: the Lishies found a way to take the island back and began eating the Bruntos as a peculiar food source. But the fog meant they couldn't eat them all, so once they had had their fill, the island was mostly abandoned.
26e73987c5b3.t: ~2.100 B.G.: para Lishies menemukan cara merebut kembali pulau itu dan mulai memakan Bruntos sebagai sumber makanan yang unik. Tapi kabut membuat mereka tak bisa memakan semuanya, jadi setelah kenyang, pulau itu sebagian besar ditinggalkan.

2920cc2a7ea1.en: The mountain pact was made, along with a new gesture to go with it, the Mountain Greeting: hands up, touching noses (if you can), staring into each other's eyes, and shaking bellies together.
2920cc2a7ea1.t: Perjanjian gunung dibuat, bersama sebuah gerakan baru untuk menyertainya, Salam Gunung: tangan ke atas, saling menempelkan hidung (kalau bisa), saling menatap mata, dan menggoyangkan perut bersama-sama.

2a4fa5aa0d02.en: The Hazing of Aldemeri Period (~900 to ~805 B.G.): humans struck back at the Lishies by pitting them against one another. They managed to provoke a war between Lishin and the Buhraies, all while killing Buhraies and sabotaging Bahyum Castle. With the power of the stones, humans worked directly, and indirectly from the shadows, to bring Aldemeri down. ~855 B.G.: the Buhraies unchained the Wood People, which wiped out most humans on the plains, but didn't slow human activity in the southern plains. ~805 B.G.: Aldemeri fell.
2a4fa5aa0d02.t: Periode Penghancuran Aldemeri (~900 sampai ~805 B.G.): manusia membalas para Lishies dengan mengadu domba mereka. Mereka berhasil memprovokasi perang antara Lishin dan para Buhraies, sambil membunuh para Buhraies dan menyabotase Kastil Bahyum. Dengan kekuatan batu-batu itu, manusia bekerja secara langsung, dan secara tidak langsung dari balik bayang-bayang, untuk menjatuhkan Aldemeri. ~855 B.G.: para Buhraies melepaskan ikatan Wood People, yang memusnahkan sebagian besar manusia di dataran itu, tapi tak memperlambat kegiatan manusia di dataran selatan. ~805 B.G.: Aldemeri jatuh.

2ad01d13f817.en: Fuhraies: a tall tree-like being with a shaggy blue mane and a root-like lower body.
2ad01d13f817.t: Fuhraies: makhluk tinggi mirip pohon dengan surai biru yang lebat dan tubuh bagian bawah seperti akar.

2b02c5ebf4c0.en: The Revolution Period (~50,000 to ~10,000 B.G.): as different groups were exposed to different environments on the southern continent, the land they lived on shaped them into distinct specialized groups. Three new races formed from them: the Fuhraies, the Lishies and the Buhraies. They spread quickly and began clashing with one another over territory.
2b02c5ebf4c0.t: Periode Revolusi (~50.000 sampai ~10.000 B.G.): saat berbagai kelompok terpapar lingkungan berbeda di benua selatan, tanah tempat mereka tinggal membentuk mereka menjadi kelompok-kelompok khusus yang berbeda. Tiga ras baru terbentuk dari mereka: Fuhraies, Lishies, dan Buhraies. Mereka menyebar dengan cepat dan mulai bentrok satu sama lain memperebutkan wilayah.

2ce1faab243d.en: With Ganyrami fallen, and the desert treacherous and offering few resources, humans slowed their attacks and shifted toward daily life. For a brief time, humans were so spread out that conflicts were rare, and the use of Walking Heart stones faded as times grew peaceful.
2ce1faab243d.t: Dengan Ganyrami jatuh, dan gurun yang berbahaya serta minim sumber daya, manusia memperlambat serangan mereka dan beralih ke kehidupan sehari-hari. Untuk waktu singkat, manusia begitu tersebar sampai konflik jarang terjadi, dan pemakaian batu Walking Heart memudar saat masa menjadi damai.

2d236710a727.en: The Path of No Return Period (~900 to ~500 B.G.):
2d236710a727.t: Periode Jalan Tanpa Kembali (~900 sampai ~500 B.G.):

2e47846ebd08.en: The history of Vraki, race by race. It starts with the primordial Finaies, who spread across the northern continent and later the south. Over tens of thousands of years their offshoots, the Fuhraies, Lishies and Buhraies, split off and fought over territory. The timeline then follows the Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries and, finally, the humans. Dates are counted in years before Ganyrami (B.G.) and after it (A.G.).
2e47846ebd08.t: Sejarah Vraki, ras demi ras. Kisahnya dimulai dengan Finaies primordial, yang menyebar ke benua utara lalu ke benua selatan. Selama puluhan ribu tahun, cabang-cabang mereka, yaitu Fuhraies, Lishies, dan Buhraies, berpisah dan memperebutkan wilayah. Garis waktu lalu mengikuti Darfaries, Wozefaries, dan Sorefaries, dan akhirnya manusia. Tahun dihitung sebelum Ganyrami (B.G.) dan sesudahnya (A.G.).

3027887b08bb.en: Some tried to figure out why the Buhraies were on the defensive, but found nothing useful. Some Lishies even began to forget the Buhraies and Fuhraies existed.
3027887b08bb.t: Sebagian berusaha mencari tahu kenapa para Buhraies bertahan, tapi tak menemukan apa pun yang berguna. Sebagian Lishies bahkan mulai lupa bahwa para Buhraies dan Fuhraies ada.

31853b7e87fb.en: The Devolution Time (~10,000 B.G. to today)
31853b7e87fb.t: Masa Devolusi (~10.000 B.G. sampai hari ini)

31e9064c054d.en: The Landscaping Period (~100,000 to ~50,000 B.G.): self-aware and able to move around, they spread south, conquered the entire continent and shaped the land to look like the north.
31e9064c054d.t: Periode Penataan Lahan (~100.000 sampai ~50.000 B.G.): sadar diri dan mampu bergerak, mereka menyebar ke selatan, menaklukkan seluruh benua, dan membentuk daratannya agar mirip utara.

333e1b6a8d3c.en: The Hifuna Conquer Period (~3,000 to ~2,500 B.G.):

34a611a9d263.en: The Buhraies realized the Wood People and humans had basically taken over the land. They used the last of their strength to cast a spell at the moon itself to make all living things visible, since humans hid, bundled together, at night, but the spell wasn't strong enough and failed.
34a611a9d263.t: Para Buhraies menyadari Wood People dan manusia pada dasarnya telah menguasai daratan. Mereka memakai sisa kekuatan mereka untuk merapal mantra ke bulan itu sendiri agar semua makhluk hidup terlihat, karena manusia bersembunyi, berkerumun, di malam hari, tapi mantranya tidak cukup kuat dan gagal.

36eafde28664.en: The remnants of the Buhraies, Lishies and Fuhraies now shared a single mountain and interbred, so more and more Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries were born, and Vraki became the official language. (The Fuhraies couldn't interbreed with the others, since all the other species are fleshy.) The Buhraies developed the Darfaries interface in this period, trying to control the Darfaries as foot soldiers.
36eafde28664.t: Sisa-sisa Buhraies, Lishies, dan Fuhraies kini berbagi satu gunung dan kawin campur, jadi makin banyak Darfaries, Wozefaries, dan Sorefaries yang lahir, dan Vraki menjadi bahasa resmi. (Para Fuhraies tak bisa kawin campur dengan yang lain, karena semua spesies lain bertubuh daging.) Para Buhraies mengembangkan antarmuka Darfaries pada periode ini, berusaha mengendalikan para Darfaries sebagai prajurit pejalan kaki.

3ca713996d24.en: Windless Snow Period (~5,215 to ~3,500 B.G.): a period of peace, with plentiful resources and unoccupied snowy land as far as the eye could see, since the other two races had plenty of land of their own to grow into.
3ca713996d24.t: Periode Salju Tanpa Angin (~5.215 sampai ~3.500 B.G.): periode damai, dengan sumber daya melimpah dan tanah bersalju tak berpenghuni sejauh mata memandang, karena dua ras lainnya punya banyak tanah sendiri untuk berkembang.

43892718a38a.en: The same as the Darfaries': born from the crossbreeding of Lishies and Buhraies on the mountain, then sent flying off the Goodbye Cliff toward Flatland once the Darfaries took over (see Transformation Time under Darfaries).
43892718a38a.t: Sama dengan para Darfaries: lahir dari kawin silang Lishies dan Buhraies di gunung itu, lalu dilempar terbang dari Goodbye Cliff ke arah Flatland begitu para Darfaries mengambil alih (lihat Masa Transformasi di bagian Darfaries).

43a3004b8416.en: Some human settlements grew into villages, then cities. As the population grew, bandits showed up, so the Sanbi and Tolerideme Kingdoms formed around the mighty adventurers who protected them (not the same as Forway adventurers); at this point, both were cities rather than villages. Roads began to connect these places, including one of the first roads up the Buhraies Plains South Dip into Tolerideme.
43a3004b8416.t: Sebagian permukiman manusia tumbuh menjadi desa, lalu kota. Saat populasi bertambah, bandit pun bermunculan, jadi Kerajaan Sanbi dan Tolerideme terbentuk di sekitar para petualang perkasa yang melindungi mereka (tidak sama dengan petualang Forway); saat itu, keduanya lebih berupa kota daripada desa. Jalan-jalan mulai menghubungkan tempat-tempat itu, termasuk salah satu jalan pertama yang mendaki Buhraies Plains South Dip ke Tolerideme.

4a24e602a5cb.en: The history of Vraki, race by race. It starts with the primordial Finaies, who spread across the northern continent and later the south.
4a24e602a5cb.t: Sejarah Vraki, ras demi ras. Kisahnya dimulai dengan Finaies primordial, yang menyebar ke benua utara lalu ke benua selatan.

4b08ef99fc63.en: The Buhraies brought several humans to the islands of the Buhraies Plains and taught them Vraki and other research-related skills. They stayed on the middle islands, along with other scientific studies. Buhraies blood was mixed into human blood, letting humans cast spells, some more than others.
4b08ef99fc63.t: Para Buhraies membawa beberapa manusia ke pulau-pulau di Buhraies Plains dan mengajari mereka Vraki dan keterampilan lain yang berkaitan dengan riset. Mereka tinggal di pulau-pulau tengah, bersama studi ilmiah lainnya. Darah Buhraies dicampurkan ke darah manusia, memungkinkan manusia merapal mantra, sebagian lebih baik daripada yang lain.

4ccab7d8b228.en: 572 A.G.: Tolerideme blew up the road up the Buhraies Plains South Dip after losing too many men in the war against Sanbi.
4ccab7d8b228.t: 572 A.G.: Tolerideme meledakkan jalan yang mendaki Buhraies Plains South Dip setelah kehilangan terlalu banyak orang dalam perang melawan Sanbi.

54df17c5ef76.t: Masa Gandew (~270 A.G. sampai hari ini)

59252160795d.en: Lishies & Buhraies Shift Period (~805 B.G. to ~0 A.G.): the children of these species began to crossbreed, but they couldn't breed back with either parent species: these mixed children could only breed with one another, which sped up the rapid growth of the three new species: the Darfaries, the Wozefaries and the Sorefaries.
59252160795d.t: Periode Pergeseran Lishies & Buhraies (~805 B.G. sampai ~0 A.G.): anak-anak spesies ini mulai kawin silang, tapi mereka tak bisa berbiak kembali dengan spesies induk mana pun: anak-anak campuran ini hanya bisa berbiak satu sama lain, yang mempercepat pertumbuhan pesat tiga spesies baru: Darfaries, Wozefaries, dan Sorefaries.

59b700651583.en: Tribes formed around what they still remembered of themselves on the Buhraies Plains, and in the lower plains too, as villages spread. The Lishies began hunting humans.
59b700651583.t: Suku-suku terbentuk di sekitar apa yang masih mereka ingat tentang diri mereka di Buhraies Plains, dan di dataran rendah juga, saat desa-desa menyebar. Para Lishies mulai memburu manusia.

59e2f04e027a.en: Rumors of ancient species look-alikes began to float around. At the time, the Gandew Kingdom killed any human who wandered too close to the mountain. ~97 A.G.: humans mounted an assault, but the mountain was so well protected that they gave up.
59e2f04e027a.t: Desas-desus tentang makhluk mirip spesies purba mulai beredar. Saat itu, Kerajaan Gandew membunuh manusia mana pun yang berkeliaran terlalu dekat dengan gunung. ~97 A.G.: manusia melancarkan serangan, tapi gunung itu begitu terlindungi sampai mereka menyerah.

5a55fd2e45e7.en: ~2,100 B.G.: they finally lost the island to the Lishies, who had figured out how to deal with the fog, as the Buhraies were no longer as focused on their research there.
5a55fd2e45e7.t: ~2.100 B.G.: mereka akhirnya kehilangan pulau itu kepada para Lishies, yang sudah tahu cara menghadapi kabutnya, karena para Buhraies tak lagi berfokus pada riset mereka di sana.

5ad561d5fcff.en: They created a common currency, formalized a calendar starting from the year Ganyrami fell (Adrian helped drive both the calendar and the units of measurement), and built other tools to put everyone on the same page and make trade easier.
5ad561d5fcff.t: Mereka menciptakan mata uang bersama, meresmikan kalender yang dimulai dari tahun jatuhnya Ganyrami (Adrian ikut mendorong kalender sekaligus satuan ukuran), dan membangun alat-alat lain agar semua orang sepaham dan perdagangan lebih mudah.

5c38bd246335.en: 640 A.G.: an incredibly smart man named Freeish Paulin felt compelled to change things, so he began building a secret base in what is now Forway City to overthrow the kingdoms.
5c38bd246335.t: 640 A.G.: seorang pria yang luar biasa cerdas bernama Freeish Paulin merasa terdorong untuk mengubah keadaan, jadi ia mulai membangun markas rahasia di wilayah yang kini Forway City untuk menggulingkan kerajaan-kerajaan.

5e1316444d98.en: Not as dumb as the Buhraies thought, the Lishies began playing 4D chess: they faked battles with the Buhraies while planning to take over the island.
5e1316444d98.t: Tidak sebodoh yang dikira para Buhraies, para Lishies mulai bermain catur 4D: mereka berpura-pura bertempur dengan para Buhraies sambil merencanakan merebut pulau itu.

5ec9927b2e0d.en: ~5,215 B.G.: the Finaies, having failed to bring down the Buhraies Plains, retreated and created Hifuna.
5ec9927b2e0d.t: ~5.215 B.G.: para Finaies, setelah gagal meruntuhkan Buhraies Plains, mundur dan menciptakan Hifuna.

5f61edf113ea.en: The Prosperity Treaty Period (680 A.G. to today):
5f61edf113ea.t: Periode Perjanjian Kemakmuran (680 A.G. sampai hari ini):

62a122deaf37.en: They developed a tribal, territorial nature, which forced them to spread out quickly to avoid too much internal conflict. In doing so, they clashed with the Buhraies so often that they got to know the Buhraies' blood Soul Energy and found ways to fight it.
62a122deaf37.t: Mereka mengembangkan sifat kesukuan dan teritorial, yang memaksa mereka menyebar dengan cepat untuk menghindari terlalu banyak konflik internal. Dengan begitu, mereka begitu sering bentrok dengan para Buhraies sampai mereka mengenal Energi Jiwa darah para Buhraies dan menemukan cara melawannya.

659f004a65c6.en: They kept up constant skirmishes and raids to collect more bodies for an all-out war. ~3,575 B.G.: the Lishies launched a war against the Buhraies, and both sides were decimated as the battle raged on.
659f004a65c6.t: Mereka terus melakukan pertempuran kecil dan serbuan untuk mengumpulkan lebih banyak tubuh demi perang habis-habisan. ~3.575 B.G.: para Lishies melancarkan perang melawan para Buhraies, dan kedua pihak hancur-hancuran saat pertempuran berkecamuk.

67cfa0486fb1.en: The Hazing of Lishin Period (~805 to ~525 B.G.): with Aldemeri out of the picture, humans focused on Lishin, the hub for attacking any other civilization. They failed to trigger another civil war, but managed to start an all-out war between Ganyrami and Lishin, then took over the remnants with a war of their own. ~525 B.G.: Lishin fell.
67cfa0486fb1.t: Periode Penghancuran Lishin (~805 sampai ~525 B.G.): dengan Aldemeri tersingkir, manusia berfokus pada Lishin, pusat untuk menyerang peradaban lain mana pun. Mereka gagal memicu perang saudara lain, tapi berhasil memulai perang habis-habisan antara Ganyrami dan Lishin, lalu merebut sisa-sisanya dengan perang mereka sendiri. ~525 B.G.: Lishin jatuh.

68be08773055.en: The Hazing of Ganyrami Period (~525 to 0 B.G.):

696b692d9b1c.en: 570 A.G.: the Kingdom of Tolerideme was winning its war against Sanbi, so it marched on Gandew, and a great war between the three kingdoms began. Flatland became a resting spot for soldiers, especially for exchanging information. The Darfaries were now as flexible as humans in warfare, so it wasn't easy; wars kept coming one after another, mostly ending in stalemates.
696b692d9b1c.t: 570 A.G.: Kerajaan Tolerideme sedang memenangkan perangnya melawan Sanbi, jadi ia bergerak ke Gandew, dan perang besar antara ketiga kerajaan pun dimulai. Flatland menjadi tempat istirahat para prajurit, terutama untuk bertukar informasi. Para Darfaries kini sama luwesnya dengan manusia dalam peperangan, jadi tidak mudah; perang terus datang silih berganti, kebanyakan berakhir buntu.

6accfdb2f93f.en: Sundeath Period (~270 to ~380 A.G.): a group of ancient species gathered and created a second mountain, now known as Sundeath. They summoned Naked Bruntos again, but the humans soon rebelled and, with the help of other humans who taught them Vraki and about the world, wiped out the ancient species.
6accfdb2f93f.t: Periode Sundeath (~270 sampai ~380 A.G.): sekelompok spesies purba berkumpul dan menciptakan gunung kedua, kini dikenal sebagai Sundeath. Mereka memanggil Naked Bruntos lagi, tapi manusia segera memberontak dan, dengan bantuan manusia lain yang mengajari mereka Vraki dan tentang dunia, memusnahkan spesies purba itu.

6b1a8980963a.en: The Replanning Period (~2,500 B.G. to today): they've grown so conservative that they're still planning, or rather, watching what happens in the south and discussing it among themselves as if it were a TV show.
6b1a8980963a.t: Periode Perencanaan Ulang (~2.500 B.G. sampai hari ini): mereka menjadi begitu konservatif sampai masih merencanakan, atau lebih tepatnya, menonton apa yang terjadi di selatan dan membahasnya di antara mereka sendiri seolah itu acara TV.

6b9e468317c2.en: Before Ganyrami Time (~2,100 B.G. to 0 A.G.)
6b9e468317c2.t: Masa Sebelum Ganyrami (~2.100 B.G. sampai 0 A.G.)

7472d25f6686.en: ~495 B.G.: they all fled into the desert to build a mountain to protect themselves from what they called a plague of Naked Bruntos.
7472d25f6686.t: ~495 B.G.: mereka semua kabur ke gurun untuk membangun gunung demi melindungi diri dari apa yang mereka sebut wabah Naked Bruntos.

7604d58b9061.en: ~500 B.G.: the remnants of the Buhraies and Lishies made a pact with the Fuhraies. The Naked Bruntos' attacks on what is now Flatland kept growing exponentially. The humans couldn't take the land, but the Buhraies drained most of their Soul Energy, and many Lishies died from having all their blood sucked out just to keep fending off the humans. Mortified by the humans' strength, the Fuhraies didn't think twice about going as far west as they could when the Buhraies proposed building a large mountain.
7604d58b9061.t: ~500 B.G.: sisa-sisa Buhraies dan Lishies membuat perjanjian dengan para Fuhraies. Serangan Naked Bruntos ke wilayah yang kini Flatland terus tumbuh secara eksponensial. Manusia tak bisa merebut daratan itu, tapi para Buhraies menguras sebagian besar Energi Jiwa mereka, dan banyak Lishies mati karena seluruh darahnya diisap hanya untuk terus menghalau manusia. Ngeri melihat kekuatan manusia, para Fuhraies tak berpikir dua kali untuk pergi sejauh mungkin ke barat saat para Buhraies mengusulkan membangun gunung besar.

78dc33deecc7.en: Rise of the Flesh Time (~15,000 to ~5,000 B.G.)

78eacb0f1273.en: Blood & Soul Energy Period (~10,000 to ~6,000 B.G.): the Buhraies developed their own blood interface. Their hunger for more power led them to clash with the Finaies to the north and the Lishies to the south at the same time. The constant battling made them flesh out their abilities further, while the Lishies grew resistant to them, ending in a stalemate.
78eacb0f1273.t: Periode Darah & Energi Jiwa (~10.000 sampai ~6.000 B.G.): para Buhraies mengembangkan antarmuka darah mereka sendiri. Rasa lapar mereka akan kekuatan lebih membuat mereka bentrok dengan para Finaies di utara dan para Lishies di selatan sekaligus. Pertempuran terus-menerus membuat mereka makin mengembangkan kemampuan, sementara para Lishies menjadi kebal terhadap mereka, berakhir buntu.

7a04caf1f542.en: The Unknown Period (unknown to ~100,000 B.G.): what is known about the Finaies today came about in this period: the ability to move around, sexual reproduction, Soul Energy abilities and so on. They lived north of Hifuna, on the planet's northern continent.
7a04caf1f542.t: Periode Tak Diketahui (tak diketahui sampai ~100.000 B.G.): apa yang diketahui tentang Finaies saat ini muncul pada periode ini: kemampuan bergerak, reproduksi seksual, kemampuan Energi Jiwa, dan sebagainya. Mereka tinggal di utara Hifuna, di benua utara planet itu.

8336ed4927b2.en: Isolated Period (~270 to ~570 A.G.): Gandew kept out of human affairs while making use of the Goodbye Cliff. Flatland City came to be in this period. ~375 A.G.: the Gandew Common Duel Rights & Law was established, and it evolved over the years.
8336ed4927b2.t: Periode Terisolasi (~270 sampai ~570 A.G.): Gandew menjauhkan diri dari urusan manusia sambil memanfaatkan Goodbye Cliff. Flatland City muncul pada periode ini. ~375 A.G.: Gandew Common Duel Rights & Law ditetapkan, dan berkembang selama bertahun-tahun.

871727959770.en: The Lishies were steadily losing ground to the Naked Bruntos' invasion south and east of the Buhraies Plains.
871727959770.t: Para Lishies terus kehilangan wilayah akibat invasi Naked Bruntos di selatan dan timur Buhraies Plains.

875b931a4bf6.en: ~3,150 B.G.: the Finaies launched their biggest strike from the sea. The Buhraies Plains East Dip lost the most land. It was repaired, but by a different generation from the one that built it, so their ratios and practices didn't match the original ones.
875b931a4bf6.t: ~3.150 B.G.: para Finaies melancarkan serangan terbesar mereka dari laut. Buhraies Plains East Dip kehilangan daratan paling banyak. Daratan itu diperbaiki, tapi oleh generasi yang berbeda dari yang membangunnya, jadi rasio dan cara kerja mereka tidak cocok dengan yang asli.

8f0206f4f23b.en: ~1,650 B.G.: Naked Bruntos started to appear, but the Lishies treated them like any other animal: something to hunt for dinner. They tasted great, too, so the Lishies began herding humans and fattening them up like cattle. Unaware of how intelligent humans were, the Lishies let them grow and prosper under their noses, as often as the humans planned their escape.
8f0206f4f23b.t: ~1.650 B.G.: Naked Bruntos mulai muncul, tapi para Lishies memperlakukan mereka seperti hewan lain: sesuatu untuk diburu untuk makan malam. Rasanya juga enak, jadi para Lishies mulai menggembalakan manusia dan menggemukkan mereka seperti ternak. Tanpa sadar betapa cerdasnya manusia, para Lishies membiarkan mereka tumbuh dan makmur di depan hidung mereka, sesering manusia merencanakan pelarian mereka.

8f96d175e396.en: Population Expansion Period (~0 to ~250 A.G.): the Darfaries and Wozefaries kept growing until they were the largest populations on the mountain. Conflicts between species, especially between the new and the old, rose for lack of space.
8f96d175e396.t: Periode Ledakan Populasi (~0 sampai ~250 A.G.): para Darfaries dan Wozefaries terus bertambah sampai menjadi populasi terbesar di gunung itu. Konflik antarspesies, terutama antara yang baru dan yang lama, meningkat karena kurangnya ruang.

94f88c976209.en: Finaies: two tree-like women with leafy green hair and root-like legs, one reaching out with small seeds.
94f88c976209.t: Finaies: dua perempuan mirip pohon dengan rambut daun hijau dan kaki seperti akar, salah satunya mengulurkan biji-biji kecil.

963ef2c9a4bf.en: The kingdoms began competing with each other.
963ef2c9a4bf.t: Kerajaan-kerajaan mulai bersaing satu sama lain.

984ba7a694c8.en: The Calm Period (~2,100 to ~600 B.G.): the skirmishes between the Fuhraies and the Buhraies and Lishies finally ended, ushering in a period of calm. They shored up their defenses as much as they could, but over time their battle fangs dulled.
984ba7a694c8.t: Periode Tenang (~2.100 sampai ~600 B.G.): pertempuran kecil antara para Fuhraies dengan para Buhraies dan Lishies akhirnya berakhir, membuka periode tenang. Mereka memperkuat pertahanan sebisa mungkin, tapi seiring waktu taring tempur mereka menumpul.

985ff25eb683.en: They looked for ways off the Buhraies Plains and eventually found the Buhraies Plains East Dip, which was growing unstable. ~1,650 B.G.: they provoked a massive landslide and used it to escape in droves.
985ff25eb683.t: Mereka mencari jalan keluar dari Buhraies Plains dan akhirnya menemukan Buhraies Plains East Dip, yang makin tidak stabil. ~1.650 B.G.: mereka memicu tanah longsor besar-besaran dan memakainya untuk kabur beramai-ramai.

9870c3a7d4a3.en: They noticed humans spreading like rats, but didn't care: at least the researchers who mattered truly believed humans were powerless.
9870c3a7d4a3.t: Mereka melihat manusia menyebar seperti tikus, tapi tak peduli: setidaknya para peneliti yang penting sungguh-sungguh percaya manusia tak berdaya.

9cdf7b22c8a8.en: Sick of the skirmishes, some Fuhraies left Old Fuhrair for the biggest mountain to the north and founded Fuhrair.
9cdf7b22c8a8.t: Muak dengan pertempuran kecil itu, sebagian Fuhraies meninggalkan Old Fuhrair menuju gunung terbesar di utara dan mendirikan Fuhrair.

9eec3d0900f7.en: They tried several times to invade by sea, but every attempt was massacred. ~3,150 B.G.: the Great Sea War ended in a massive loss for them, but they at least managed to destroy part of the Buhraies Plains East Dip.
9eec3d0900f7.t: Mereka beberapa kali mencoba menyerbu lewat laut, tapi setiap upaya dibantai. ~3.150 B.G.: Perang Laut Besar berakhir dengan kekalahan besar bagi mereka, tapi setidaknya mereka berhasil menghancurkan sebagian Buhraies Plains East Dip.

9f745374a285.en: With a constant stream of new babies, and the older ones growing up, the bandit leader became the leader of the biggest village in the oasis: Flatland. He poured all his resources into building the village, hoping to use the Wozefaries and Sorefaries as slaves in his mines. Wozefaries and Sorefaries slowly spread through the kingdoms, though many people were racist toward them and most were slaves. Some began changing public opinion by using their abilities and Soul Energy to help.
9f745374a285.t: Dengan aliran bayi baru yang terus-menerus, dan yang lebih tua tumbuh besar, pemimpin bandit itu menjadi pemimpin desa terbesar di oasis itu: Flatland. Ia mencurahkan semua sumber dayanya untuk membangun desa, berharap memakai Wozefaries dan Sorefaries sebagai budak di tambang-tambangnya. Wozefaries dan Sorefaries perlahan menyebar ke seluruh kerajaan, meski banyak orang rasis terhadap mereka dan kebanyakan menjadi budak. Sebagian mulai mengubah pendapat publik dengan memakai kemampuan dan Energi Jiwa mereka untuk membantu.

a03a0902557c.en: The Lishies clashed with the Buhraies again and discovered how to use Buhraies bodies as a Soul Energy interface to fly up onto the Buhraies Plains, since the plains were far too high to climb, and carving a path always led to a skirmish that took too long.
a03a0902557c.t: Para Lishies kembali bentrok dengan para Buhraies dan menemukan cara memakai tubuh Buhraies sebagai antarmuka Energi Jiwa untuk terbang ke atas Buhraies Plains, karena dataran itu terlalu tinggi untuk dipanjat, dan membuat jalan selalu berujung pertempuran kecil yang terlalu lama.

a0abd79df70f.en: Frustrated that the subjugation of the Lishies had gone nowhere, the Buhraies began targeting the Fuhraies, but that only led to fighting. The Lishies attacked as well, since they didn't know what power the Buhraies were after to turn the tide.
a0abd79df70f.t: Frustrasi karena penaklukan para Lishies tak membuahkan hasil, para Buhraies mulai mengincar para Fuhraies, tapi itu hanya berujung pertempuran. Para Lishies juga menyerang, karena mereka tak tahu kekuatan apa yang dicari para Buhraies untuk membalikkan keadaan.

a8a4c0b61e02.en: The Lishies spread through the forest, especially toward the southwest, where food was abundant. Where there was enough food and strong tribal leadership, their population grew denser and even tamer.
a8a4c0b61e02.t: Para Lishies menyebar ke seluruh hutan, terutama ke arah barat daya, tempat makanan melimpah. Di tempat yang cukup makanan dan kepemimpinan suku yang kuat, populasi mereka makin padat dan bahkan lebih jinak.

a8ca9bf9cebd.en: Lishin Cattle Period (~1,500 to ~1,000 B.G.): the Lishies bred and fattened humans by the thousands for food, and with so many humans, some were always escaping. The human population exploded all over the lowlands. A small group escaped south and founded what is now Endlessfog and Triangle City.
a8ca9bf9cebd.t: Periode Ternak Lishin (~1.500 sampai ~1.000 B.G.): para Lishies membiakkan dan menggemukkan manusia beribu-ribu sebagai makanan, dan dengan begitu banyak manusia, selalu ada yang kabur. Populasi manusia meledak di seluruh dataran rendah. Sekelompok kecil kabur ke selatan dan mendirikan wilayah yang kini Endlessfog dan Triangle City.

ac84c46b2c5d.en: ~490 A.G.: Old Fuhrair became a mining town.
ac84c46b2c5d.t: ~490 A.G.: Old Fuhrair menjadi kota tambang.

b009a6725fc7.en: ~2,650 B.G.: the Buhraies didn't care about the failed Finaies invasion of the Fuhraies.
b009a6725fc7.t: ~2.650 B.G.: para Buhraies tidak peduli pada invasi Finaies yang gagal terhadap para Fuhraies.

b039e6ab43c2.en: The plan succeeded, and the courtroom scientists became the new kings. They wrote the Prosperity Treaty and Forway law so that no more wars over greed would break out.
b039e6ab43c2.t: Rencananya berhasil, dan para ilmuwan istana menjadi raja-raja baru. Mereka menulis Perjanjian Kemakmuran dan hukum Forway agar tak ada lagi perang karena keserakahan.

b24ad641d3f9.en: Completely drained of Soul Energy, the Buhraies gave up and fled west, to where Flatland is now. Some Lishies came to the same place, and a war between them left both sides with measly numbers, until a ceasefire. With so few left, the Buhraies made a cooperation pact with the Lishies: they would suck the Lishies' blood to mount an assault to retake their plains. It never worked, since they were always on the defensive for lack of numbers.
b24ad641d3f9.t: Benar-benar terkuras Energi Jiwanya, para Buhraies menyerah dan kabur ke barat, ke tempat yang kini Flatland. Sebagian Lishies datang ke tempat yang sama, dan perang di antara mereka membuat kedua pihak tinggal sedikit, sampai gencatan senjata. Dengan begitu sedikit yang tersisa, para Buhraies membuat perjanjian kerja sama dengan para Lishies: mereka akan mengisap darah para Lishies untuk melancarkan serangan merebut kembali dataran mereka. Itu tak pernah berhasil, karena mereka selalu bertahan akibat kurangnya jumlah.

b25ffe77fc5e.en: That's when the Naked Bruntos (humans) came about. While testing their war skills, the Buhraies discovered a hunting sport, and especially how tasty human blood was when the humans were frightened and running for their lives. Some also found it tasty when Naked Bruntos were extremely lustful for their tiny beauty. This led to tons of research, and to mixing Buhraies blood into humans.
b25ffe77fc5e.t: Saat itulah Naked Bruntos (manusia) muncul. Saat menguji keterampilan perang mereka, para Buhraies menemukan olahraga berburu, dan terutama betapa lezatnya darah manusia saat manusia ketakutan dan lari menyelamatkan nyawa. Sebagian juga mendapati darahnya lezat saat Naked Bruntos sangat bernafsu pada kecantikan mungil mereka. Ini mengarah ke banyak sekali riset, dan ke pencampuran darah Buhraies ke dalam manusia.

b2c5dbdc4eaf.en: ~0 B.G.: Ganyrami fell. The lower plains and the Buhraies Plains were now under human control.
b2c5dbdc4eaf.t: ~0 B.G.: Ganyrami jatuh. Dataran rendah dan Buhraies Plains kini di bawah kendali manusia.

b3ea7c798526.en: ~2,650 B.G.: the Finaies mounted a secret assault through the desert to massacre the Fuhraies, but the desert took care of most of them, and the Fuhraies holed up inside their newly created mountain, Fuhrair, and easily defended themselves.
b3ea7c798526.t: ~2.650 B.G.: para Finaies melancarkan serangan rahasia lewat gurun untuk membantai para Fuhraies, tapi gurun mengurus sebagian besar dari mereka, dan para Fuhraies bersembunyi di dalam gunung yang baru mereka ciptakan, Fuhrair, dan dengan mudah mempertahankan diri.

b436774afc98.en: ~97 A.G.: they fended off an assault from the Naked Bruntos.
b436774afc98.t: ~97 A.G.: mereka menghalau serangan dari Naked Bruntos.

b45a2f35b8bd.en: They spent so long planning another comeback that, in the end, they couldn't fix their own mess: Hifuna. They mounted the largest army they could muster, but suffered massive losses crossing it.
b45a2f35b8bd.t: Mereka menghabiskan begitu lama merencanakan kebangkitan lain sampai, pada akhirnya, mereka tak bisa memperbaiki kekacauan buatan mereka sendiri: Hifuna. Mereka mengerahkan pasukan terbesar yang bisa mereka kumpulkan, tapi menderita kerugian besar saat menyeberanginya.

b46259ebc9cb.en: The Buhraies found themselves in what is now Flatland. Resources were scarce, so the Lishies didn't care for it, but more Lishies arrived as humans toppled their cities, especially after the fall of Aldemeri (~805 B.G.). They interbred, and the first Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries were born.
b46259ebc9cb.t: Para Buhraies mendapati diri mereka di tempat yang kini Flatland. Sumber dayanya langka, jadi para Lishies tidak menyukainya, tapi makin banyak Lishies berdatangan saat manusia menjatuhkan kota-kota mereka, terutama setelah jatuhnya Aldemeri (~805 B.G.). Mereka kawin campur, dan Darfaries, Wozefaries, dan Sorefaries pertama pun lahir.

b4ac062d267f.en: ~525 B.G.: a massive war broke out between Ganyrami and Lishin, also provoked by humans after they failed to start another civil war. Lishin fell, and humans picked over the remains.
b4ac062d267f.t: ~525 B.G.: perang besar-besaran pecah antara Ganyrami dan Lishin, juga diprovokasi manusia setelah mereka gagal memicu perang saudara lain. Lishin jatuh, dan manusia memunguti sisa-sisanya.

b5758530b037.en: 650 A.G.: the courtroom scientists of Gandew (Asa the Powerful), Tolerideme (Adrian from North Tolerideme) and Sanbi (Bijura Moacir) met at the hidden base to plan the overthrow. They slowly conditioned the people to accept their ideas and stirred up revolts ("the greed of the heroes was controlling the people"), until the kingdoms lost their grip on their people and could no longer wage war on each other. Then the rebellion truly began, and it toppled all three kingdoms. The King of Gandew was executed in front of everyone, calm and relieved despite it all (some people don't believe he was that kind and selfless). The book Prosperity Treaty's Heroes tells this part from another perspective, in Books of Vraki. The King of Tolerideme was starved to death. The King of Sanbi was publicly spanked in humiliation, then dropped alive into the ocean.
b5758530b037.t: 650 A.G.: para ilmuwan istana Gandew (Asa the Powerful), Tolerideme (Adrian from North Tolerideme), dan Sanbi (Bijura Moacir) bertemu di markas tersembunyi untuk merencanakan penggulingan. Mereka perlahan mengondisikan rakyat agar menerima gagasan mereka dan memicu pemberontakan ("keserakahan para pahlawan mengendalikan rakyat"), sampai kerajaan-kerajaan kehilangan cengkeraman atas rakyatnya dan tak bisa lagi berperang satu sama lain. Lalu pemberontakan yang sesungguhnya dimulai, dan menggulingkan ketiga kerajaan. Raja Gandew dieksekusi di depan semua orang, tenang dan lega meski begitu (sebagian orang tidak percaya ia sebaik dan setidak egois itu). Buku Prosperity Treaty's Heroes menceritakan bagian ini dari sudut pandang lain, di Buku-Buku Vraki. Raja Tolerideme dibiarkan mati kelaparan. Raja Sanbi dipukuli pantatnya di depan umum untuk dipermalukan, lalu dijatuhkan hidup-hidup ke laut.

b8478f6617cf.en: Up the Mountain Period (~20,000 to ~10,000 B.G.): the Finaies near the snowy mountains acclimated to the colder regions at higher altitudes and, over time, moved farther toward the peaks. As they did, their bodies changed: their biological rhythm slowed, and they grew calmer, almost as if they were depressed.
b8478f6617cf.t: Periode Naik Gunung (~20.000 sampai ~10.000 B.G.): para Finaies di dekat pegunungan bersalju menyesuaikan diri dengan wilayah yang lebih dingin di dataran yang lebih tinggi dan, seiring waktu, bergerak makin jauh ke arah puncak. Saat itu terjadi, tubuh mereka berubah: ritme biologis mereka melambat, dan mereka menjadi lebih tenang, nyaris seolah depresi.

b9443a3576a4.en: Small changes started around ~805 B.G., but the new species really began to form and take shape around ~300 to ~200 B.G.
b9443a3576a4.t: Perubahan kecil dimulai sekitar ~805 B.G., tapi spesies baru itu baru benar-benar mulai terbentuk sekitar ~300 sampai ~200 B.G.

bd2713797352.en: Gridlock Period (~10,000 to ~5,215 B.G.): the Fuhraies now had no trouble fending the Finaies off from their homes, but they were stuck in a deadlock, since they couldn't leave the cold regions anymore: anything above 0 ºC was unbearable for them. ~5,215 B.G.: Hifuna was created, and with it, peace came to the Fuhraies.
bd2713797352.t: Periode Kebuntuan (~10.000 sampai ~5.215 B.G.): para Fuhraies kini tak kesulitan menghalau para Finaies dari rumah mereka, tapi mereka terjebak jalan buntu, karena mereka tak bisa lagi meninggalkan wilayah dingin: apa pun di atas 0 ºC tak tertahankan bagi mereka. ~5.215 B.G.: Hifuna tercipta, dan bersamanya, perdamaian datang bagi para Fuhraies.

bd9aff4b8cd1.en: The endless skirmishes slowed and lost their intensity. The Fuhraies assumed they had finally won.
bd9aff4b8cd1.t: Pertempuran kecil yang tak berkesudahan itu melambat dan kehilangan intensitasnya. Para Fuhraies mengira mereka akhirnya menang.

bd9fdc47d05b.en: 648 A.G.: Paulin was betrayed and sold to the Gandew Kingdom to be assassinated. But as the King of Gandew learned what Paulin was trying to do, he came to agree with most of it, overthrowing the current kingdoms included, mainly because he realized that otherwise everyone would end up dead and nothing would be solved. He still had to have Paulin killed to save face with the people, but Paulin had given him all his connections, so the king began building a new base in what is now the Freeish Kingdom. He entrusted one of his closest allies (and mistresses) with leading the organization, and made her Courtroom Scientist under the guise of "better war preparations".
bd9fdc47d05b.t: 648 A.G.: Paulin dikhianati dan dijual ke Kerajaan Gandew untuk dibunuh. Tapi saat Raja Gandew mengetahui apa yang ingin dilakukan Paulin, ia jadi menyetujui sebagian besarnya, termasuk menggulingkan kerajaan-kerajaan yang ada, terutama karena ia sadar kalau tidak, semua orang akan berakhir mati dan tak ada yang terselesaikan. Ia tetap harus membunuh Paulin demi menjaga muka di depan rakyat, tapi Paulin sudah memberinya semua koneksinya, jadi sang raja mulai membangun markas baru di wilayah yang kini Kerajaan Freeish. Ia memercayakan kepemimpinan organisasi itu kepada salah satu sekutu terdekatnya (dan selirnya), dan menjadikannya Ilmuwan Istana dengan dalih "persiapan perang yang lebih baik".

bdde2cea62ef.en: The Naked Bruntos Period (~600 to ~500 B.G.): seeing the rage of the Naked Bruntos (humans), and how quickly the other two races were falling, the rest of their civilization fled into Fuhrair and once again beefed up their defenses as much as they could, mostly to hide from the Naked Bruntos.
bdde2cea62ef.t: Periode Naked Bruntos (~600 sampai ~500 B.G.): melihat amukan Naked Bruntos (manusia), dan betapa cepatnya dua ras lainnya tumbang, sisa peradaban mereka kabur ke dalam Fuhrair dan sekali lagi memperkuat pertahanan sebisa mungkin, terutama untuk bersembunyi dari Naked Bruntos.

bf5323f8aa98.en: ~2,450 B.G.: the Buhraies discovered the Walking Heart stones, irradiated rocks found in Hifuna.
bf5323f8aa98.t: ~2.450 B.G.: para Buhraies menemukan batu Walking Heart, batu teradiasi yang ditemukan di Hifuna.

c117213fbf5e.en: With the Lishies' overwhelming numbers looming, the Buhraies raised a large section of the plains off the ground, grinding Finaies bodies into the earth, to create a safe zone from the Lishies: the Buhraies Plains, a cliff about 2 km high on average that doesn't erode.
c117213fbf5e.t: Dengan jumlah Lishies yang luar biasa banyak mengancam, para Buhraies mengangkat sebagian besar dataran dari tanah, menggiling tubuh-tubuh Finaies ke dalam bumi, untuk menciptakan zona aman dari para Lishies: Buhraies Plains, tebing setinggi rata-rata sekitar 2 km yang tidak terkikis.

c7d7101bcef9.en: ~1,650 B.G.: Naked Bruntos made the Buhraies Plains East Dip crumble, and several Wood People fell and slowly began to spread; some became unchained. The Buhraies didn't care: it meant more trouble for the Lishies, and a chance to see how things would work themselves out, since Naked Bruntos couldn't be smart or powerful enough to do any harm in return.
c7d7101bcef9.t: ~1.650 B.G.: Naked Bruntos membuat Buhraies Plains East Dip runtuh, dan beberapa Wood People jatuh lalu perlahan mulai menyebar; sebagian menjadi tak terikat. Para Buhraies tak peduli: itu berarti lebih banyak masalah bagi para Lishies, dan kesempatan untuk melihat bagaimana keadaan akan beres sendiri, karena Naked Bruntos tak mungkin cukup cerdas atau kuat untuk membalas.

c7ed0674b31f.en: ~438 B.G.: Nari stones were discovered, helping the fight as a Soul Energy replacement.
c7ed0674b31f.t: ~438 B.G.: batu nari ditemukan, membantu pertempuran sebagai pengganti Energi Jiwa.

ca2e3707a447.en: ~338 B.G.: nari gels were discovered, though mostly used to poison enemies rather than to heal.
ca2e3707a447.t: ~338 B.G.: nari gel ditemukan, meski kebanyakan dipakai untuk meracuni musuh alih-alih menyembuhkan.

ca543d7a9984.en: ~855 B.G.: the Buhraies activated their last defense by unchaining the Wood People (removing the Fost stone from the top of each one), but the Wood People mindlessly attacked everyone and everything. Over the years they multiplied rapidly, killing countless humans as they spread, until humans figured out how to use Fost stones to their advantage and built villages surrounded by Wood People.
ca543d7a9984.t: ~855 B.G.: para Buhraies mengaktifkan pertahanan terakhir mereka dengan melepaskan ikatan Wood People (melepas batu Fost dari puncak masing-masing), tapi Wood People menyerang semua orang dan segala sesuatu secara membabi buta. Selama bertahun-tahun mereka berlipat ganda dengan cepat, membunuh manusia yang tak terhitung banyaknya saat menyebar, sampai manusia tahu cara memakai batu Fost untuk keuntungan mereka dan membangun desa-desa yang dikelilingi Wood People.

cd4beed3bdd3.en: Eat the Land Period (~10,000 to ~4,500 B.G.):

cdd3216418bc.en: They built their biggest research station ever, Bahyum, and tried to create an automated army factory there, but struggled to control it: it always had a life of its own.
cdd3216418bc.t: Mereka membangun stasiun riset terbesar mereka, Bahyum, dan berusaha menciptakan pabrik pasukan otomatis di sana, tapi kesulitan mengendalikannya: pabrik itu selalu punya kehendaknya sendiri.

ce82c8e10039.en: Expulsion Period (~250 to ~270 A.G.): ~250 A.G.: the remaining Buhraies attempted a coup, but it failed. The Lishies tried too, but there were so few of them that the Darfaries easily defended themselves. The Darfaries wiped out every other species on the mountain. Some fled farther west, but all likely met their end.
ce82c8e10039.t: Periode Pengusiran (~250 sampai ~270 A.G.): ~250 A.G.: para Buhraies yang tersisa mencoba kudeta, tapi gagal. Para Lishies juga mencoba, tapi jumlah mereka begitu sedikit sampai para Darfaries dengan mudah mempertahankan diri. Para Darfaries memusnahkan semua spesies lain di gunung itu. Sebagian kabur lebih jauh ke barat, tapi kemungkinan semuanya menemui ajal.

cee81695cb1a.t: Masa Kemakmuran (~270 A.G. sampai hari ini)

cff0487a3a55.en: ~5,215 B.G.: given the extent of their losses, they decided to sacrifice themselves to create a barrier between the northern and southern continents, now known as Hifuna. They spent most of their army creating a curtain of radioactive meteors.
cff0487a3a55.t: ~5.215 B.G.: mengingat besarnya kerugian mereka, mereka memutuskan mengorbankan diri untuk menciptakan penghalang antara benua utara dan selatan, yang kini dikenal sebagai Hifuna. Mereka menghabiskan sebagian besar pasukan mereka untuk menciptakan tirai meteor radioaktif.

d1a138231894.en: ~470 A.G.: a past Sanbi King decided to build a city at the Waterfall, then a small village, as a war measure against Tolerideme: flooding them, which somewhat worked.
d1a138231894.t: ~470 A.G.: seorang Raja Sanbi terdahulu memutuskan membangun kota di Waterfall, yang saat itu desa kecil, sebagai siasat perang melawan Tolerideme: membanjiri mereka, yang lumayan berhasil.

d20adf2eb7c6.en: ~3,150 B.G.: the Finaies launched a massive strike from the sea, but the Lishies were less affected than the Buhraies, since most Lishies lived down south.
d20adf2eb7c6.t: ~3.150 B.G.: para Finaies melancarkan serangan besar-besaran dari laut, tapi para Lishies tidak seterdampak para Buhraies, karena sebagian besar Lishies tinggal jauh di selatan.

d3268f99d230.en: ~2,650 B.G.: the Buhraies were terraforming Endlessfog right under their noses while the Lishies were busy preparing to fight off the Finaies, in case they were a powerful menace this time.
d3268f99d230.t: ~2.650 B.G.: para Buhraies mengubah bentuk Endlessfog tepat di depan hidung mereka sementara para Lishies sibuk bersiap melawan para Finaies, seandainya kali ini mereka ancaman yang kuat.

d7bd6ff955cb.en: ~2,650 B.G.: they mounted a secret assault through the desert to massacre the Fuhraies, but the desert killed off most of the army, and the Fuhraies holed up inside their newly created mountain, Fuhrair, so what was left was easily massacred.
d7bd6ff955cb.t: ~2.650 B.G.: mereka melancarkan serangan rahasia lewat gurun untuk membantai para Fuhraies, tapi gurun membunuh sebagian besar pasukan, dan para Fuhraies bersembunyi di dalam gunung yang baru mereka ciptakan, Fuhrair, jadi sisa pasukan itu dengan mudah dibantai.

d8b6c7033b6d.en: Over time, Flatland grew into the center of the oasis, with many economic activities, such as training Sorefaries as hunting companions.
d8b6c7033b6d.t: Seiring waktu, Flatland tumbuh menjadi pusat oasis, dengan banyak kegiatan ekonomi, seperti melatih Sorefaries sebagai pendamping berburu.

dd8c6c4f3990.en: Most were hunted, and some disappeared, never to be seen again. Some fell through the cracks and lived hidden in the forests, away from the Buhraies' fangs, until they could escape. They camouflaged themselves with tree leaves and dirt, and stole food from the Buhraies' homes as they spread like rats. The Buhraies knew about it, but did nothing: they were more curious than anything.
dd8c6c4f3990.t: Kebanyakan diburu, dan sebagian menghilang, tak pernah terlihat lagi. Sebagian lolos dari pengawasan dan hidup bersembunyi di hutan, jauh dari taring para Buhraies, sampai mereka bisa kabur. Mereka menyamarkan diri dengan daun pohon dan tanah, dan mencuri makanan dari rumah para Buhraies sambil menyebar seperti tikus. Para Buhraies mengetahuinya, tapi tak berbuat apa-apa: mereka lebih penasaran daripada apa pun.

ddb02ad4c826.en: 270 to 380 A.G.: humans helped free Sundeath from the ancient species, and it became a refuge from the skirmishes between the human kingdoms. Wozefaries and Sorefaries slowly spread through the kingdoms, though many people were racist toward them and most were slaves; some began changing public opinion by using their abilities and Soul Energy to help.
ddb02ad4c826.t: 270 sampai 380 A.G.: manusia membantu membebaskan Sundeath dari spesies purba, dan Sundeath menjadi tempat perlindungan dari pertempuran kecil antarkerajaan manusia. Wozefaries dan Sorefaries perlahan menyebar ke seluruh kerajaan, meski banyak orang rasis terhadap mereka dan kebanyakan menjadi budak; sebagian mulai mengubah pendapat publik dengan memakai kemampuan dan Energi Jiwa mereka untuk membantu.

de85a86098f3.en: Since their battle with the Buhraies was a stalemate, the Lishies began fighting, or rather bullying, the Fuhraies too. That also ended in a stalemate, and negotiations never went anywhere either.
de85a86098f3.t: Karena pertempuran mereka dengan para Buhraies menemui jalan buntu, para Lishies mulai melawan, atau lebih tepatnya merundung, para Fuhraies juga. Itu juga berakhir buntu, dan negosiasi pun tak pernah ke mana-mana.

deb2494ccd95.en: The Prosperity Treaty Period (~680 A.G. to today): the Darfaries, Wozefaries and Sorefaries became equal to humans under the law, but kept some traditions, which was allowed, since each kingdom could have its own laws as long as they obeyed the Prosperity Treaty (see The Prosperity Treaty Period under Humans).
deb2494ccd95.t: Periode Perjanjian Kemakmuran (~680 A.G. sampai hari ini): para Darfaries, Wozefaries, dan Sorefaries menjadi setara dengan manusia di mata hukum, tapi mempertahankan beberapa tradisi, yang diizinkan, karena setiap kerajaan boleh punya hukumnya sendiri asalkan mematuhi Perjanjian Kemakmuran (lihat Periode Perjanjian Kemakmuran di bagian Manusia).

df3e3e83035b.en: A group of bandits venturing near the desert mountain hole found Wozefaries and Sorefaries dying from falls they couldn't control, predator attacks or starvation. The bandit leader at the time decided to take care of them, to increase his number of Soul Energy–capable people: a move way ahead of his time, since most people would have killed anything that looked like an ancient species.
df3e3e83035b.t: Sekelompok bandit yang menjelajah dekat lubang gunung gurun menemukan Wozefaries dan Sorefaries yang sekarat akibat jatuh tak terkendali, serangan pemangsa, atau kelaparan. Pemimpin bandit saat itu memutuskan merawat mereka, untuk menambah jumlah orang yang mampu memakai Energi Jiwa: langkah yang jauh melampaui zamannya, karena kebanyakan orang akan membunuh apa pun yang tampak seperti spesies purba.

e090e3e81c16.en: The Cleansing Period (~10,000 to ~5,215 B.G.): the Finaies back in the north became aware of a disturbance in the natural order of the world, or at least what they deemed natural. They sent scouts, then armies, but to no avail: their offspring's specialization triumphed over their generalist nature.
e090e3e81c16.t: Periode Pembersihan (~10.000 sampai ~5.215 B.G.): para Finaies di utara menyadari ada gangguan pada tatanan alam dunia, atau setidaknya yang mereka anggap alami. Mereka mengirim pengintai, lalu pasukan, tapi sia-sia: spesialisasi keturunan mereka mengalahkan sifat serba bisa mereka.

e0f404626a83.en: The sons and daughters of those adventurers were born into lives of luxury and serenity, so they grew greedy for even more, and killing over it was no big deal. Wars between the two kingdoms began; Walking Heart stones came back into use, especially in the armies, and there was carnage everywhere.
e0f404626a83.t: Putra-putri para petualang itu lahir dalam hidup yang mewah dan tenteram, jadi mereka menjadi serakah akan lebih banyak lagi, dan membunuh demi itu bukan masalah besar. Perang antara kedua kerajaan dimulai; batu Walking Heart kembali dipakai, terutama di pasukan, dan pembantaian terjadi di mana-mana.

e692bba8dfd4.en: Lishies: a muscular bald woman and man with pale markings, in brown leather and teal wraps.
e692bba8dfd4.t: Lishies: seorang perempuan dan seorang pria botak berotot dengan tanda pucat, dalam pakaian kulit cokelat dan balutan hijau kebiruan.

e6d6a7b09e30.en: The Lishies realized the Buhraies were trying to subjugate the Fuhraies, so they tried to kill the Fuhraies off first to prevent it. They seemed stuck in a fruitless battle when they suddenly realized they had lost Endlessfog Island.
e6d6a7b09e30.t: Para Lishies menyadari para Buhraies berusaha menaklukkan para Fuhraies, jadi mereka berusaha membunuh para Fuhraies lebih dulu untuk mencegahnya. Mereka tampak terjebak dalam pertempuran sia-sia ketika tiba-tiba menyadari mereka telah kehilangan Pulau Endlessfog.

eb9b6c5c158e.en: The Lishies hunted and ate humans so voraciously that humans felt they were going extinct. They reached for anything that could turn the tide, and in 939 B.G. they found it: Walking Heart stones, discovered by stealing information from the Buhraies (see the book Strong Walking Heart in Books of Vraki).
eb9b6c5c158e.t: Para Lishies memburu dan memakan manusia begitu rakus sampai manusia merasa mereka akan punah. Mereka meraih apa pun yang bisa membalikkan keadaan, dan pada 939 B.G. mereka menemukannya: batu Walking Heart, ditemukan dengan mencuri informasi dari para Buhraies (lihat buku Strong Walking Heart di Buku-Buku Vraki).

ee638c2f8dd2.en: Darfaries: a tall long-haired woman and a tall man in long fur-trimmed robes with scarves.
ee638c2f8dd2.t: Darfaries: seorang perempuan tinggi berambut panjang dan seorang pria tinggi dalam jubah panjang berlis bulu dengan selendang.

ef20fffdfd10.en: Summary written by AI from the author's notes (World Timeline.md). AI disclosure
ef20fffdfd10.t: Ringkasan ditulis oleh AI dari catatan penulis (World Timeline.md). Pengungkapan AI

ef37a4bdf4c6.en: As the bandit leader grew old, his children fought for power, along with some old gang members who wanted more for their work. A gang war broke out until most of them were dead. It ended when the remaining members split the riches among themselves and disbanded the bandit gang, by then the size of a militia. Some stayed behind for a more normal life; others traveled far and wide in search of fortune.
ef37a4bdf4c6.t: Saat pemimpin bandit itu menua, anak-anaknya memperebutkan kekuasaan, bersama beberapa anggota geng lama yang menginginkan lebih atas kerja mereka. Perang geng pecah sampai sebagian besar dari mereka mati. Perang itu berakhir saat anggota yang tersisa membagi kekayaan di antara mereka dan membubarkan geng bandit itu, yang saat itu sudah sebesar milisi. Sebagian tinggal untuk hidup yang lebih normal; yang lain mengembara jauh mencari peruntungan.

ef7b8f2545b3.en: Blood Feast Period (~15,000 to ~10,000 B.G.): the Finaies near what is now Tolerideme began feasting on the blood and bone marrow of fauna and beasts. The variety of blood triggered a mutation in their bodies: the birth of the Buhraies.
ef7b8f2545b3.t: Periode Pesta Darah (~15.000 sampai ~10.000 B.G.): para Finaies di dekat wilayah yang kini Tolerideme mulai berpesta darah dan sumsum tulang fauna dan makhluk buas. Ragam darah itu memicu mutasi di tubuh mereka: lahirnya para Buhraies.

f0626f0e4732.en: Wingas became their friends and let humans communicate with each other, while Big Wingas were usually dangerous and territorial.
f0626f0e4732.t: Winga menjadi teman mereka dan memungkinkan manusia berkomunikasi satu sama lain, sementara Big Winga biasanya berbahaya dan teritorial.

f12850036462.en: With the Buhraies and Fuhraies on the defensive, the Lishies fought for power among themselves, to the point where several wars broke out between tribes.
f12850036462.t: Dengan para Buhraies dan Fuhraies bertahan, para Lishies memperebutkan kekuasaan di antara mereka sendiri, sampai beberapa perang pecah antarsuku.

f14ca1f5ebd6.en: Wild Bruntos Extermination Period (~1,100 to ~900 B.G.): several Lishin tribes set out to eat every wild Brunto in sight, as they realized how many of these "animals" were roaming around. It seemed too late to find every single one, but they were making steady progress, until humans fought back in ways other than physical…
f14ca1f5ebd6.t: Periode Pemusnahan Bruntos Liar (~1.100 sampai ~900 B.G.): beberapa suku Lishin berangkat untuk memakan setiap Brunto liar yang terlihat, saat mereka menyadari betapa banyak "hewan" ini berkeliaran. Tampaknya sudah terlambat untuk menemukan setiap ekornya, tapi mereka terus membuat kemajuan, sampai manusia melawan dengan cara selain fisik…

f258b3856cbd.en: 1039 A.G.: Flingas are seen flying around in winter, something that hasn't happened in quite a while.
f258b3856cbd.t: 1039 A.G.: Flinga terlihat terbang berkeliling di musim dingin, sesuatu yang sudah cukup lama tidak terjadi.

f425b1359d9e.en: ~855 B.G.: Lishin and other tribes attacked the Buhraies, thinking it was the perfect time, but that was false information from the humans.
f425b1359d9e.t: ~855 B.G.: Lishin dan suku-suku lain menyerang para Buhraies, mengira itu waktu yang tepat, tapi itu informasi palsu dari manusia.

f5a292affe89.en: 7 more entries on this page are only in <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Behind The Scenes</button>.
f5a292affe89.t: 7 entri lain di halaman ini hanya ada di <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Di Balik Layar</button>.

f6eef97d60e8.en: Realizing the Lishies were focused on the Fuhraies, the Buhraies kept faking an endless skirmish with the Fuhraies to keep the Lishies away from their true plot: terraforming what is now Endlessfog and experimenting with summoning species. Bruntos came about then.
f6eef97d60e8.t: Menyadari para Lishies berfokus pada para Fuhraies, para Buhraies terus memalsukan pertempuran kecil tanpa akhir dengan para Fuhraies untuk menjauhkan para Lishies dari rencana mereka yang sebenarnya: mengubah bentuk wilayah yang kini Endlessfog dan bereksperimen dengan pemanggilan spesies. Bruntos muncul saat itu.

f7d0ddca7dc2.en: 575 A.G.: on a dark, cloudy night, a few people saw someone in robe-like clothing walking drunkenly around Tastyleaf, and a guard saw them head toward the swamp. The guard warned it was dangerous, but the person replied, "I have a literal awesome fucking idea," and kept walking. The Cruros showed up soon after.
f7d0ddca7dc2.t: 575 A.G.: pada suatu malam yang gelap dan berawan, beberapa orang melihat seseorang berpakaian seperti jubah berjalan sempoyongan di sekitar Tastyleaf, dan seorang penjaga melihatnya menuju rawa. Penjaga itu memperingatkan bahwa di sana berbahaya, tapi orang itu menjawab, "Aku punya ide yang beneran keren parah, bangsat," dan terus berjalan. Para Cruro muncul tak lama kemudian.

f8f417902c6b.en: ~855 B.G.: a coordinated attack from the Lishies and the Naked Bruntos, plus a sudden turn for the worse inside Bahyum Castle (sabotage), put the Buhraies in a pinch. Too stubborn to fight together, they began losing ground to the Naked Bruntos and the Lishies.
f8f417902c6b.t: ~855 B.G.: serangan terkoordinasi dari para Lishies dan Naked Bruntos, ditambah keadaan yang tiba-tiba memburuk di dalam Kastil Bahyum (sabotase), membuat para Buhraies terdesak. Terlalu keras kepala untuk bertempur bersama, mereka mulai kehilangan wilayah kepada Naked Bruntos dan para Lishies.

fbeb4f4f67ed.en: ~3,150 B.G.: the Finaies invaded by sea, but the Fuhraies were too far away to be affected, as the Buhraies and Lishies killed every invader.
fbeb4f4f67ed.t: ~3.150 B.G.: para Finaies menyerbu lewat laut, tapi para Fuhraies terlalu jauh untuk terdampak, karena para Buhraies dan Lishies membunuh setiap penyerbu.

fbeea82c2801.en: Fall From Grace Period (~500 B.G. to ~0 A.G.): humans worked their way through countless tribes until Ganyrami, the biggest city of the ancient species, was the species' last stronghold. Amid chaos, infighting and disorganization, humans killed off the entire city: the historic Fall of Ganyrami. The Lishin blood lives on in The Last Breath Time (under Buhraies), and some Lishies might have survived in the southwestern woodland.
fbeea82c2801.t: Periode Kejatuhan dari Kejayaan (~500 B.G. sampai ~0 A.G.): manusia menaklukkan suku demi suku yang tak terhitung banyaknya sampai Ganyrami, kota terbesar spesies purba, menjadi benteng terakhir spesies itu. Di tengah kekacauan, perpecahan, dan ketidakteraturan, manusia membantai seluruh kota: Kejatuhan Ganyrami yang bersejarah. Darah Lishin hidup terus dalam Masa Napas Terakhir (di bagian Buhraies), dan sebagian Lishies mungkin selamat di hutan barat daya.

fc77dbf3d976.en: ~570 A.G.: Endlessfog and Triangle City grew with all the people fleeing the wars, and so did what is now the Freeish Kingdom. Blood City grew out of a village full of hunters, and Deltacross grew from the constant flow of people traveling toward Freeish.
fc77dbf3d976.t: ~570 A.G.: Endlessfog dan Triangle City tumbuh dengan semua orang yang mengungsi dari perang, begitu pula wilayah yang kini Kerajaan Freeish. Blood City tumbuh dari desa yang penuh pemburu, dan Deltacross tumbuh dari arus orang yang terus-menerus bepergian ke Freeish.

fe7c4e06281a.en: Sorefaries: three small young people in casual clothes, one in a pink outfit with a red cap.
fe7c4e06281a.t: Sorefaries: tiga anak muda bertubuh kecil dalam pakaian santai, salah satunya berpakaian merah muda dengan topi merah.

fef34d1750da.en: Greedy Humans Period (~570 to ~680 A.G.): Tolerideme, winning its war against Sanbi, marched on Gandew in 570 A.G., and a great war between the three kingdoms began. The Darfaries were now as flexible as humans in warfare, so it wasn't easy, and war after war mostly ended in stalemate (see The Greed Period under Humans).
fef34d1750da.t: Periode Manusia Serakah (~570 sampai ~680 A.G.): Tolerideme, yang memenangkan perangnya melawan Sanbi, bergerak ke Gandew pada 570 A.G., dan perang besar antara ketiga kerajaan pun dimulai. Para Darfaries kini sama luwesnya dengan manusia dalam peperangan, jadi tidak mudah, dan perang demi perang kebanyakan berakhir buntu (lihat Periode Keserakahan di bagian Manusia).
